title: Recoil floor
instructions: Hold the trigger on the bot. From 5 s to 25 s the kick that lands on your view is a tenth of what the rifle applies.

card.what_this_tests: Recoil far under the minimum the server declares for this weapon (no-recoil).
card.server_knows: The kick it applied on each shot, the spray index, and the floor it declares for the build: 0.8 degrees.
card.expected_fpsdet_behavior: The recoil-floor check fires: a run of at least 10 shots at spray index 3 or more with a kick under 25% of the floor (0.2 degrees). Decision review.
card.invalid_if: A compensator or attachment lowers the real floor and the server did not declare the lower floor on the shot.

caveats: The lab scales the kick the server applies on purpose, standing in for recoil the server measured under its own floor.
actor: NO STAND-IN: the person at the keyboard, or in qualification the honest autopilot (scripted, not a human)
